name: S.E.E.S.
howToStart: Starts on its own and ranks up with the story.

name: Kenji Tomochika
howToStart: Starts on its own. Hang out with Kenji after school to rank it up.

name: Fuuka Yamagishi
howToStart: Needs max Courage and the Fortune link already started.

name: Mitsuru Kirijo
howToStart: Needs max Academics (Genius).

name: Hidetoshi Odagiri
howToStart: Join the student council when Mitsuru asks you.

name: Bunkichi & Mitsuko
howToStart: Find the persimmon leaf at the tree by the school's 1F corridor and bring it to the old couple.
location: Bookworms used books, Iwatodai Strip Mall

name: Yukari Takeba
howToStart: Needs max Charm. Opens after the Yakushima trip.

name: Kazushi Miyamoto
howToStart: Join a sports team (the track team).

name: Chihiro Fushimi
howToStart: Start the Emperor link, then speak to Chihiro on three different days.
note: Guides list start dates from early to late May.

name: Maya
howToStart: Play the MMORPG Junpei gives you on the computer in your room.

name: Keisuke Hiraga
howToStart: Join a culture club (the art club).

name: Yuko Nishiwaki
howToStart: Walk Yuko home when the Chariot link offers it at its early ranks.

name: Maiko Oohashi
howToStart: Give Maiko a Weird Takoyaki (Octopia, Iwatodai Strip Mall) and a Mad Bull (dorm vending machine), then come back another day.

name: Pharos
howToStart: Starts on its own and ranks up with the story.

name: Bebe
howToStart: Needs Hierophant rank 3 and Academics rank 2 or higher.

name: President Tanaka
howToStart: Needs Charm rank 4. Give him ¥20,000, then ¥10,000 on two later nights (¥40,000 in total).
note: Some guides tie the start to Hermit rank 4 rather than a date.

name: Mutatsu
howToStart: Needs Strength rank 4 and Courage rank 4. Ask Yuko about the monk, then find him at Club Escapade.

name: Mamoru Hayase
howToStart: Talk to Mamoru after meeting him at the 8/2 sports meet.

name: Nozomi Suemitsu
start: After Kenji mentions the Gourmet King
howToStart: Needs Charm rank 2. Pass Nozomi's gourmet quiz, then give him an Odd Morsel (found in Tartarus).

name: Akinari Kamiki
howToStart: Needs Academics rank 4 and Hanged Man rank 3. Meet Akinari at the shrine, then bring him the Red Fountain Pen.
note: Guides list start dates from early August to early September.

name: Nyx Annihilation Team
howToStart: Starts on its own if the Fool link is maxed by 12/31, and ranks up with the story.

name: Aigis
howToStart: Starts on its own on 1/8.
